title: Central Government Holiday List 2027: Gazetted, Restricted Holidays and Long Weekends
seoTitle: Central Government Holiday List 2027: Dates, RH, Weekdays
seoDescription: DoPT's 2027 list gives Delhi central government offices 17 gazetted holidays and 2 restricted holidays from 32. See every date, weekday and long weekend.
excerpt: One merged calendar of all 49 gazetted and restricted holidays with weekdays, the 14+3+2 rule explained, how state-capital committees change the list outside Delhi, and a leave planner for 2027's longest breaks.
